findings.description: The regex check was changed from `match.match` to `match.fullmatch`. This is unrelated to accepting an empty message and tightens matching semantics.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `retry_if_exception_message(match="timeout")` with an exception whose message is "timeout after 5s". The old code's prefix match would retry. `fullmatch` now returns False, so the exception is not retried. Existing users of `match=` silently change behavior.
